questions.explanation: 3 reams × 500 sheets = 1,500 sheets a week, and 1,500 × 8 = 12,000 sheets.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: A petty cash fund starts with ₱5,000. Expenses of ₱1,275, ₱860 and ₱1,415 are paid from it. How much is left?

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Forms are numbered from 0451 to 0525, including both. How many forms are there?
questions.explanation: 525 − 451 = 74, plus 1 because both the first and last forms are counted: 75.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: An employee earns ₱650 a day and works 22 days in a month. Deductions of ₱1,430 are taken from the pay. What is the net pay?

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which article of the 1987 Constitution contains the Bill of Rights?
questions.explanation: Article III is the Bill of Rights. Article II is the Declaration of Principles and State Policies, Article IV is Citizenship, and Article VI is the Legislative Department.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What is Republic Act No. 6713 commonly known as?
questions.correct: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees
wrong: Ease of Doing Business and Efficient Government Service Delivery Act
questions.explanation: RA 6713 is the Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees. The Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act is RA 3019, the Ease of Doing Business and Efficient Government Service Delivery Act is RA 11032, and the New Government Procurement Act is RA 12009.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 6713, public officials and employees must respond to letters and requests from the public within how many working days from receipt?
questions.explanation: Section 5(a) of RA 6713 requires a response within fifteen working days from receipt.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which branch of government has the power to interpret laws and settle legal disputes?
questions.explanation: Judicial power belongs to the Supreme Court and the lower courts (Article VIII). The Legislative branch makes laws and the Executive branch carries them out.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, what is the term of office of the President?
questions.explanation: Article VII, Section 4 gives the President a single term of six years and bars re-election.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: How many Senators make up the Senate of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 2 states that the Senate is composed of twenty-four Senators elected at large.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What is the minimum age required to be elected President of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Article VII, Section 2 requires the President to be at least forty years of age on the day of the election.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article IX of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following is NOT one of the Constitutional Commissions?
questions.explanation: Article IX names three Constitutional Commissions: the Civil Service Commission, the Commission on Elections and the Commission on Audit. The Commission on Human Rights is created separately under Article XIII.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which document does RA 6713 require public officials and employees to file under oath?
questions.correct: Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth
questions.explanation: Section 8 of RA 6713 requires public officials and employees to file under oath a Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth, known as the SALN.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which law is known as the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000?
questions.explanation: RA 9003 is the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000. RA 8749 is the Clean Air Act, RA 9275 is the Clean Water Act, and RA 9147 is the Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which document, adopted by the United Nations General Assembly in 1948, sets out basic rights for all people?
questions.explanation: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights was adopted on 10 December 1948. The UN Charter dates from 1945 and the Geneva Conventions from 1949.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which independent office created by the 1987 Constitution investigates human rights violations in the Philippines?
questions.explanation: The Commission on Human Rights is created under Article XIII of the 1987 Constitution to investigate human rights violations.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which right protects a person from being tried twice for the same offense?
questions.explanation: Article III, Section 21 of the 1987 Constitution states that no person shall be twice put in jeopardy of punishment for the same offense.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: The writ of habeas corpus is a remedy against what?
questions.explanation: Habeas corpus orders that a detained person be brought before a court so the legality of the detention can be examined.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 11054, passed in 2018, is known as what law?
questions.explanation: RA 11054 is the Organic Law for the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao. The Local Government Code is RA 7160, the IPRA is RA 8371, and the Anti-Terrorism Act is RA 11479.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What is the Republic Act number of the Indigenous Peoples' Rights Act of 1997?
questions.explanation: RA 8371 is the Indigenous Peoples' Rights Act. RA 7160 is the Local Government Code, RA 9262 protects women and children against violence, and RA 10173 is the Data Privacy Act.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What is the Republic Act number of the Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act of 2004?
questions.explanation: RA 9262 is the Anti-VAWC Act. RA 9710 is the Magna Carta of Women, RA 7877 is the Anti-Sexual Harassment Act, and RA 8353 is the Anti-Rape Law of 1997.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 9275 is known as what law?
wrong: Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000
questions.explanation: RA 9275 is the Clean Water Act. The Clean Air Act is RA 8749, the solid waste law is RA 9003, and the Mining Act is RA 7942.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 9003, what is the main purpose of a Materials Recovery Facility (MRF)?
questions.correct: To receive, sort and process recyclable and compostable waste
questions.explanation: RA 9003 requires MRFs where waste is sorted so that recyclables and compostables are recovered instead of going to disposal sites.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which body was created by the Climate Change Act of 2009 (RA 9729)?
wrong: Department of Environment and Natural Resources
questions.explanation: RA 9729 created the Climate Change Commission to coordinate government policy on climate change. The DENR and its bureaus already existed.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, what is the term of office of a Senator?
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 4: Senators serve six years and may not serve more than two consecutive terms.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, what is the term of office of a Member of the House of Representatives?
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 7: Members of the House serve three years and may not serve more than three consecutive terms.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Who is the Commander-in-Chief of all armed forces of the Philippines?
wrong: The Chief of Staff of the AFP
questions.explanation: Article VII, Section 18 of the 1987 Constitution makes the President the Commander-in-Chief of all armed forces.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which article of the 1987 Constitution provides for the Civil Service Commission and the other Constitutional Commissions?
questions.explanation: Article IX covers the Constitutional Commissions. Article VII is the Executive Department, Article VIII the Judicial Department, and Article XI Accountability of Public Officers.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What is the minimum age required to be elected Senator?
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 3 requires a Senator to be at least thirty-five years old on the day of the election. (25 is the minimum for the House.)

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What is the process by which citizens directly propose and enact laws, as recognized in the 1987 Constitution?
questions.explanation: Article VI, Section 32 provides for initiative and referendum, through which the people can directly propose and enact laws.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the norms of conduct listed in RA 6713?
questions.explanation: Section 4 of RA 6713 lists commitment to public interest, professionalism, justness and sincerity, political neutrality, responsiveness to the public, nationalism and patriotism, commitment to democracy, and simple living. Seniority is not one of them.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 6713, may a public employee accept a gift from someone with a transaction pending in their office?
wrong: Yes, if it is worth less than ₱5,000
Yes, if it is declared in the SALN
questions.explanation: Section 7(d) of RA 6713 prohibits soliciting or accepting gifts in the course of official duties or in connection with any transaction that may be affected by the functions of their office.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article II of the 1987 Constitution, the Philippines is described as what kind of State?
questions.explanation: Article II, Section 1: "The Philippines is a democratic and republican State."

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: According to the 1987 Constitution, where does sovereignty reside?
questions.explanation: Article II, Section 1: "Sovereignty resides in the people and all government authority emanates from them."

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: The 1987 Constitution declares that ___ authority is, at all times, supreme over the military.
questions.explanation: Article II, Section 3 states that civilian authority is, at all times, supreme over the military.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, what is the minimum age to vote?
questions.explanation: Article V: a voter must be at least 18, and must have lived in the Philippines for at least one year and in the place of voting for at least six months.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: How many members make up the Supreme Court of the Philippines?
questions.correct: A Chief Justice and 14 Associate Justices
wrong: A Chief Justice and 12 Associate Justices
A Chief Justice and 8 Associate Justices
A Chief Justice and 15 Associate Justices
questions.explanation: Article VIII, Section 4: the Supreme Court has a Chief Justice and fourteen Associate Justices, fifteen members in all.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which body has the exclusive power to initiate all cases of impeachment?
questions.explanation: Article XI, Section 3: the House of Representatives initiates impeachment; the Senate tries and decides the case.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which body has the sole power to try and decide impeachment cases?
questions.explanation: Article XI, Section 3(6): the Senate has the sole power to try and decide all cases of impeachment.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which of the following officials is NOT removable by impeachment under the 1987 Constitution?
wrong: A Justice of the Supreme Court
questions.explanation: Article XI, Section 2 lists the President, the Vice President, members of the Supreme Court and the Constitutional Commissions, and the Ombudsman. Senators are disciplined by the Senate itself.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: "Public office is a public trust" opens which Article of the 1987 Constitution?
questions.correct: Article XI, Accountability of Public Officers
questions.explanation: Article XI, Section 1 begins: "Public office is a public trust."

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, a proclamation of martial law may last no longer than how many days unless Congress extends it?
questions.explanation: Article VII, Section 18: martial law may be declared for a period not exceeding sixty days. Congress may revoke it or extend it at the President's request.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What is the term of office of the Chairman and Commissioners of the Civil Service Commission?
questions.explanation: Article IX-B, Section 1(2): they serve a term of seven years without reappointment.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Article IX-B of the 1987 Constitution, appointments in the civil service are made according to what?
questions.explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(2): appointments are based on merit and fitness, determined as far as practicable by competitive examination.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, which of these is prohibited for officers and employees in the civil service?
questions.correct: Engaging in electioneering or partisan political campaigns
questions.explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(4) prohibits electioneering and partisan political campaigns. Section 2(5) guarantees the right to self-organization, so joining a union is allowed.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: The civil service covers government-owned or controlled corporations that have what?
questions.explanation: Article IX-B, Section 2(1): the civil service covers all government agencies, including government-owned or controlled corporations with original charters, that is, those created by a special law.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which Article of the 1987 Constitution deals with local government?
questions.explanation: Article X covers local government. Article VIII is the Judicial Department, XII the National Economy and Patrimony, and XIII Social Justice and Human Rights.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What is the term of office of elective local officials other than barangay officials?
questions.correct: Three years, up to three consecutive terms
wrong: Four years, up to two consecutive terms
questions.explanation: Article X, Section 8: three years, and no official may serve more than three consecutive terms. Barangay officials' terms are set by law.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, what is the national language of the Philippines?
questions.explanation: Article XIV, Section 6: "The national language of the Philippines is Filipino." Filipino and English are the official languages for communication and instruction.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: A people's initiative to amend the Constitution needs a petition signed by at least what percent of all registered voters?
questions.explanation: Article XVII, Section 2: at least 12% of all registered voters, with every legislative district represented by at least 3% of its registered voters.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: The 1987 Constitution was ratified in a plebiscite held on what date?
questions.explanation: The plebiscite was held on February 2, 1987. February 25, 1986 is the end of the EDSA People Power Revolution, and January 17, 1973 is linked to the 1973 Constitution.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 6713, the Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) must be filed on or before what date every year?
questions.explanation: Section 8: the SALN is filed on or before April 30 of every year, as well as within 30 days of taking office and of leaving it.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 6713, within how many days of assuming office must an official divest themselves of shareholdings or interest in a private business that conflicts with their position?
questions.explanation: Section 9 of RA 6713 requires the official to resign from any position in the private business within 30 days of assuming office, and to divest the shareholdings or interest within 60 days.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 6713, for how long after leaving government is a former official barred from practicing their profession in connection with any matter before their former office?
questions.explanation: Section 7(b): the prohibition applies within one year after resignation, retirement or separation from office.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which norm of conduct under RA 6713 requires public officials to lead modest lives appropriate to their positions and income?
questions.explanation: Section 4(h), simple living: officials and their families must lead modest lives and must not indulge in extravagant or ostentatious display of wealth.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 6713, what does "political neutrality" require of public officials and employees?
questions.correct: Serving everyone without unfair discrimination, regardless of party affiliation
wrong: Supporting the party of the President
questions.explanation: Section 4(d): public officials and employees shall provide service to everyone without unfair discrimination and regardless of party affiliation or preference.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which law created the Anti-Red Tape Authority (ARTA)?
questions.explanation: RA 11032, the Ease of Doing Business and Efficient Government Service Delivery Act of 2018, created ARTA. It amended RA 9485, the Anti-Red Tape Act of 2007.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 11032, what is the maximum processing time for a simple transaction in a government office?
questions.explanation: Section 9(b) of RA 11032 sets the maximum processing time at 3 working days for simple transactions, 7 working days for complex ones, and 20 working days for highly technical ones.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the Ease of Doing Business Act, government offices must post a document listing their services, requirements, fees and processing times. What is it called?
wrong: Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth
questions.explanation: The Citizen's Charter tells the public step by step how to get each service, what to bring, what it costs and how long it takes.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 3019 is known as what law?
questions.explanation: RA 3019 (1960) defines and penalizes corrupt practices of public officers.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which law is the Local Government Code of 1991?
questions.explanation: RA 7160 sets out the powers, structure and funding of provinces, cities, municipalities and barangays.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which agency administers and enforces the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173)?
wrong: Department of Information and Communications Technology
questions.explanation: RA 10173 created the National Privacy Commission to enforce the law and protect personal information.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under Philippine procurement law (RA 9184, now replaced by the New Government Procurement Act, RA 12009), what is the general rule for government procurement?
questions.explanation: Both RA 9184 and RA 12009, which replaced it in 2024, make public competitive bidding the general rule. Direct contracting, negotiated procurement and shopping are alternative methods allowed only in specific cases.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which office investigates and prosecutes public officials for illegal acts, under the 1987 Constitution and RA 6770?
questions.explanation: Under Article XI, Sections 12 and 13 of the 1987 Constitution and RA 6770, the Ombudsman acts as protector of the people, investigating complaints against public officials and employees and prosecuting those found liable.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Human Rights Day is observed every year on what date?
questions.explanation: It marks the day in 1948 when the UN General Assembly adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which United Nations treaty is specifically about the rights of children?
questions.correct: Convention on the Rights of the Child
wrong: Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women
International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights
questions.explanation: The Convention on the Rights of the Child (1989) sets out the rights of every person under 18. The Philippines ratified it in 1990.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: CEDAW is an international treaty that protects the rights of which group?
questions.explanation: CEDAW is the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination Against Women.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 9710 is known as what law?
wrong: Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act
questions.explanation: RA 9710 (2009) is the Magna Carta of Women. The Anti-Violence Against Women and Their Children Act is RA 9262.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which law, also called the "Bawal Bastos" law, penalizes gender-based sexual harassment in streets, public places, online and at work?
questions.explanation: RA 11313 (2019) covers harassment by anyone, including strangers. RA 7877 (1995) covers harassment by persons in authority at work or school.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act (RA 9344), a child of what age or below at the time of the offense is exempt from criminal liability?
questions.explanation: A child 15 or below is exempt but goes through an intervention program. A child above 15 and below 18 is also exempt unless they acted with discernment.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which law makes torture by persons in authority a crime and states that no exceptional circumstance, such as war or a threat of war, can justify it?
wrong: RA 9344, the Juvenile Justice and Welfare Act
RA 7610, the Special Protection of Children Act
questions.explanation: RA 9745 treats freedom from torture as an absolute right that cannot be set aside under any circumstance.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 7610 gives special protection to which group?
questions.correct: Children, against abuse, exploitation and discrimination
questions.explanation: RA 7610 (1992) is the Special Protection of Children Against Abuse, Exploitation and Discrimination Act.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 8749 is known as what law?
wrong: Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000
questions.explanation: RA 8749 sets air quality standards and controls pollution from vehicles and industries. The Clean Water Act is RA 9275.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which law protects the country's wild plants and animals and their habitats?
questions.correct: RA 9147, the Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act
wrong: RA 9003, the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act
questions.explanation: RA 9147 (2001) regulates the collection, trade and protection of wildlife.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the Philippine Environmental Impact Statement System (PD 1586), what must a project that may harm the environment obtain before it can proceed?
questions.explanation: The ECC, issued by the DENR's Environmental Management Bureau, certifies that the project has gone through the impact assessment and will follow its environmental conditions.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under RA 9003, the Ecological Solid Waste Management Act, where should solid waste first be segregated?
questions.correct: At the source, such as homes and offices
questions.explanation: RA 9003 requires segregation at the source, so waste is already sorted before it is collected.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which international agreement was made to phase out substances that damage the ozone layer?
questions.explanation: The Montreal Protocol (1987) phases out ozone-depleting chemicals such as CFCs. Kyoto and Paris deal with greenhouse gases, and Ramsar with wetlands.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: What is the main goal of the Paris Agreement of 2015?
questions.correct: Limit global warming to well below 2°C above pre-industrial levels
questions.explanation: Countries agreed to keep warming well below 2°C and to try to limit it to 1.5°C by cutting greenhouse gas emissions.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which gas, released mainly by burning fossil fuels, is the biggest contributor to human-caused global warming?
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide traps heat in the atmosphere. Oxygen, nitrogen and argon are not greenhouse gases.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Republic Act No. 11038 of 2018, which added more protected areas to the national system, is known as what law?
wrong: Wildlife Resources Conservation and Protection Act
questions.explanation: RA 11038 is the Expanded National Integrated Protected Areas System Act. It amended RA 7586, the original NIPAS Act of 1992.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Which law created the National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (NDRRMC)?
questions.explanation: RA 10121 is the Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010. RA 9729 is the Climate Change Act.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Earth Day is observed every year on what date?
questions.explanation: Earth Day is April 22. June 5 is World Environment Day and March 22 is World Water Day.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: The Comprehensive Agreement on the Bangsamoro, signed in 2014, was an agreement between the Philippine government and which group?
questions.explanation: The 2014 agreement with the MILF led to the Bangsamoro Organic Law (RA 11054). The government's 1996 agreement was with the MNLF.

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, who has the power to grant reprieves, commutations and pardons after conviction by final judgment?
questions.explanation: Article VII, Section 19 gives this power to the President, except in cases of impeachment. Amnesty also needs the agreement of a majority of all the members of Congress.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.correct: How a mentoring program helped an office keep its new employees
wrong: Why senior staff dislike training new employees
Why neighboring towns lose so many employees
questions.explanation: The passage describes the turnover problem, the buddy program set up to solve it and the results. The other choices are minor details or are not discussed.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: According to the passage, what do the volunteer buddies get in return for mentoring?
questions.correct: Their mentoring hours count toward their training requirement
wrong: A small allowance added to their monthly pay
Priority in the next round of promotions
Exemption from the weekly staff meetings
questions.explanation: The third paragraph says the volunteers "receive no extra pay, but their mentoring hours are counted toward their annual training requirement."

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Why does the passage mention that the office shared its guidelines with three neighboring municipalities?
questions.correct: To show that others saw the program as worth copying
wrong: To show that the program had become too costly
To explain why the office lost new employees
To suggest that the buddies came from other towns
questions.explanation: Other towns facing the same problem asked for the guidelines, which implies they saw the program as a model. Nothing in the passage mentions its cost.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: As used in the passage, the word "skeptical" most nearly means:
questions.explanation: The senior staff worried that the meetings would slow down their work, so they doubted the program at first. Hopeful and excited are the opposite.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang pangunahing ideya ng talata?
questions.correct: Naging kapaki-pakinabang na halamanan ang dating tambakan ng basura
wrong: Maraming daga sa mga bakanteng lote ng barangay
Mahal ang mga binhing kailangan sa paghahalaman
Ipinagbibili nang mahal ang mga gulay ng barangay
questions.explanation: Isinasalaysay ng buong talata kung paano ginawang halamanan ang lote at kung ano ang naging bunga nito. Maliliit na detalye o mali ang ibang pagpipilian.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ayon sa talata, saan nagmula ang mga binhing itinanim sa lote?
questions.correct: Sa tanggapan ng agrikultura ng munisipyo
wrong: Sa samahan ng kababaihan ng barangay
Sa kinita mula sa pagbebenta ng ani
questions.explanation: Tahasang sinasabi ng ikalawang talata na "nagbigay ng libreng binhi ang tanggapan ng agrikultura ng munisipyo."

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Batay sa paggamit ng kinikita ng halamanan, ano ang mahihinuha tungkol dito?
questions.correct: Kaya na nitong tustusan ang sarili nitong pangangailangan
wrong: Umaasa pa rin ito sa pondo ng munisipyo
Pinagkakakitaan ito ng mga opisyal ng barangay
Malapit na itong isara dahil sa kakulangan
questions.explanation: Ang kinikita ay ibinibili ng kagamitan at binhi para sa susunod na taniman, kaya hindi na ito kailangang pondohan ng iba. Ang libreng binhi ay sa simula lamang binanggit.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng salitang "dinarayo" sa huling talata?
questions.explanation: Sinasabi ng talata na "hindi na iniiwasan ang lote. Sa halip, dinarayo na ito," kaya ang dinarayo ay ang kabaligtaran ng iniiwasan: pinupuntahan.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "cordial".
questions.explanation: A cordial greeting is warm and friendly. Rude is the opposite.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "prudent".
questions.explanation: A prudent person acts with good judgment and thinks ahead. Reckless is the opposite, and proud only looks similar.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "tenacious".
questions.explanation: Tenacious means holding on firmly and not giving up easily, which is closest to persistent.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "lucid".
questions.explanation: A lucid explanation is clear and easy to understand. Confusing is the opposite, and lucky only sounds similar.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word closest in meaning to "imminent".
questions.explanation: Imminent describes something that will happen very soon, as in "an imminent storm". "Highly respected" is the meaning of eminent, a different word.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "conceal".
questions.explanation: To conceal is to hide something, so its opposite is reveal. Hide is a synonym.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "lenient".
questions.explanation: A lenient supervisor is not harsh with rules or punishment. The opposite is strict. Tolerant is close to a synonym.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "meager".
questions.explanation: Meager means too small in amount, as in "a meager salary". Ample means more than enough. Scanty is a synonym.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Choose the word opposite in meaning to "ephemeral".
questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting only a short time. Its opposite is enduring, which means lasting a long time. Fleeting is a synonym.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The mayor ___ the new health center yesterday.
questions.explanation: "Yesterday" points to a finished time in the past, so the simple past "opened" is needed. The present perfect "has opened" is not used with a specific past time.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: There ___ several complaints filed at the front desk last week.
questions.explanation: In a sentence starting with "there", the verb agrees with the noun that follows. "Complaints" is plural and "last week" is past, so the verb is "were".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The bus ___ already left by the time we reached the terminal.
questions.explanation: Of two past actions, the earlier one takes the past perfect. The bus left before we arrived, so the sentence needs "had already left".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ten kilometers ___ too far for the volunteers to walk in the heat.
questions.explanation: A distance, amount of money or period of time is treated as one unit, so it takes a singular verb even if the noun is plural: "Ten kilometers is too far."

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question:
Which part of the sentence contains an error?
This year's report / is more better / than the one / we submitted last year.
questions.explanation: "Better" is already the comparative form of "good", so "more" must be removed: "This year's report is better than the one we submitted last year."

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question:
Which part of the sentence contains an error?
The supervisor / didn't say / nothing / about the delay.
questions.explanation: "Didn't" and "nothing" together form a double negative. The sentence should read "The supervisor didn't say anything about the delay."

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question:
Which part of the sentence contains an error?
Despite of / the heavy traffic, / the applicant / arrived on time.
questions.explanation: "Despite" is never followed by "of". Use "Despite the heavy traffic" or "In spite of the heavy traffic".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question:
Which part of the sentence contains an error?
The clerk / has submitted / the payroll / two days ago.
questions.explanation: "Two days ago" names a finished past time, which needs the simple past: "The clerk submitted the payroll two days ago." The present perfect cannot be used with "ago".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Attendance at the safety orientation is ___; no employee may skip it.
questions.explanation: "No employee may skip it" means everyone must attend, so the orientation is mandatory. Optional and voluntary mean the opposite.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The auditor found a ___ between the amount in the ledger and the cash in the vault.
questions.explanation: An auditor "finds" a problem; a discrepancy is a difference between two things that should match. The other choices all mean the two amounts agree.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The speaker read his notes in such a monotonous voice that half the audience fell asleep. What does "monotonous" mean in this sentence?
questions.explanation: A monotonous voice stays on one tone without variety, which is why the listeners grew bored and fell asleep.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Although the evidence against the employee seemed ___, the panel refused to decide until it had heard his side.
questions.explanation: "Although" signals a contrast: the evidence seemed strong, yet the panel still waited. Weak evidence such as flimsy or doubtful would give no reason for the contrast.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does the idiom "to go the extra mile" mean?
questions.correct: To make more effort than is expected
wrong: To quit a job for a better one
To arrive late for an appointment
questions.explanation: Someone who goes the extra mile does more than what is required. "To travel farther than planned" is only the literal reading.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does the idiom "to beat around the bush" mean?
wrong: To search a place very carefully
To finish a task in a hurry
questions.explanation: A person who beats around the bush talks about other things instead of getting to the point.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What does the idiom "to pass the buck" mean?
questions.correct: To shift responsibility to someone else
wrong: To lend money to a friend in need
To share credit for a success
To take a short break from work
questions.explanation: To pass the buck is to blame or hand a problem to another person instead of dealing with it yourself.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: The director ___ the staff for finishing the project ahead of schedule.
questions.explanation: To compliment is to praise. To complement is to complete or go well with something, as in "the scarf complements her dress."

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Please order more office ___ such as envelopes, bond paper and letterheads.
questions.explanation: Stationery (with -ery) means writing materials. Stationary (with -ary) means not moving. Stationery has no plural form.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: From the tone of the memo, the staff could ___ that the director was displeased.
questions.explanation: The reader infers, or draws a conclusion; the writer implies, or suggests it. Here the staff are the ones drawing the conclusion, so "infer" is correct.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question:
Arrange the sentences into a logical paragraph.
(A) As a result, most clearances are now released within a day.
(B) For years, residents waited up to a week for a barangay clearance.
(C) Staff could then prepare the documents before residents arrived.
(D) To solve this, the barangay began accepting requests online.
questions.explanation: B states the problem. D ("to solve this") gives the solution, C ("then") explains how it worked, and A ("as a result") ends with the outcome.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang kasingkahulugan ng salitang "dukha"?
questions.explanation: Ang dukha ay taong salat sa kabuhayan, kaya mahirap ang kasingkahulugan nito. Ang mayaman ang kasalungat.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang kahulugan ng salitang "pagsusumamo"?
questions.explanation: Ang pagsusumamo ay taimtim na paghiling o pakikiusap, kaya pagmamakaawa ang kahulugan nito. Kahawig lamang ng tunog ang pagsusumbong.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang kasalungat ng salitang "maagap"?
questions.explanation: Ang maagap ay mabilis kumilos at hindi nagpapahuli. Ang makupad ay mabagal at kulang sa sigla, kaya ito ang kasalungat.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng sawikaing "makapal ang mukha"?
questions.explanation: Ang taong makapal ang mukha ay hindi nahihiya kahit gumagawa ng hindi kanais-nais. Ang "mataba ang pisngi" ay literal na kahulugan lamang.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng sawikaing "itaga mo sa bato"?
questions.correct: Tandaan mo dahil tiyak na mangyayari ito
wrong: Maging matigas ka sa iyong desisyon
questions.explanation: Ginagamit ito kapag nangangako o nagbabala ang nagsasalita: kasintibay ng nakaukit sa bato ang kanyang sinasabi, kaya dapat itong tandaan.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Piliin ang wastong salita: Ito ang aklat na ___ hiniram sa aklatan kahapon.
questions.explanation: Ang "kong" ay "ko" na may pang-angkop na -ng (aklat na aking hiniram). Ang "kung" ay pangatnig na ginagamit sa kondisyon, gaya ng "kung uulan".

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Piliin ang wastong salita: ___ mo ang bakuran bago dumating ang mga bisita.
questions.explanation: Ginagamit ang hulaping -an kapag lugar ang tinutukoy (walisan ang bakuran). Ang -in ay para sa bagay na mismong inaalis (walisin ang kalat).

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.correct: How an online booking system shortened the wait for business permits
wrong: Why older business owners refuse to use the city's website
How applicants should prepare papers for a building permit
Why the permit office set aside windows for senior citizens
questions.explanation: The passage describes the long lines, the new reservation system and the shorter waiting time that followed. The other choices are minor details or go beyond the passage.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: According to the passage, what does the system do when an applicant books a time slot?
questions.correct: It lists the documents required for the applicant's business
wrong: It charges a small fee to hold the applicant's reservation
It approves the applicant's permit before the actual visit
It sends the applicant's papers directly to the city hall
questions.explanation: The second paragraph says, "When they book, the system lists the documents required for their type of business."

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What most likely explains why far fewer applicants were turned away for incomplete papers?
questions.correct: Applicants learned which documents they needed before arriving
wrong: The office stopped checking documents during busy months
Walk-in applicants were no longer served by the office
Barangay staff now complete the papers for every applicant
questions.explanation: The system lists the required documents at booking "so they can complete their papers before they arrive," which explains the drop. Barangay staff only book slots for those who cannot use the website.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: As used in the passage, the word "noticeable" most nearly means:
questions.explanation: Right after "The results were noticeable," the passage gives a large, plain change: waiting time fell from six hours to under forty minutes. Hardly felt is the opposite.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: What is the main purpose of the advisory?
questions.correct: To urge residents to remove mosquito breeding sites before the rains
wrong: To announce a schedule of fogging for every barangay in town
To explain how dengue patients are treated in the hospital
To warn residents against swimming in rivers and swamps
questions.explanation: Most of the advisory tells households how to find and remove still water, and it calls this "the most effective protection." Fogging is limited to areas with confirmed cases.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: According to the advisory, where does the dengue mosquito lay its eggs?
questions.correct: In clean, still water in containers
wrong: In rivers and swamps near the town
In piles of dry leaves on the ground
In muddy water along the roadsides
questions.explanation: The advisory says the mosquito "lays its eggs in clean, still water, often in containers found around the home," and not in rivers or swamps.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Why does the advisory point out that spraying does not kill the eggs and larvae?
questions.correct: To show why fogging cannot replace the weekly search at home
wrong: To show why fogging will be done in every part of town
To suggest that fogging is harmful to the residents' health
To explain why dengue cases rise from June to September
questions.explanation: Since eggs and larvae survive spraying, mosquitoes will keep coming back unless containers are emptied, which is why the advisory says removing breeding sites "remains the most effective protection."

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: As used in the advisory, the word "effective" most nearly means:
questions.explanation: Removing breeding sites is compared with fogging, which leaves eggs and larvae alive; it is the protection that works best, so effective means successful.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang pangunahing ideya ng talata?
questions.correct: Inilapit ng umiikot na klinika ang serbisyong pangkalusugan sa malayong sitio
wrong: Kulang ang mga doktor at nars sa lahat ng health center ng munisipyo
Luma na at kailangang palitan ang ambulansiya ng munisipyo
Mapanganib para sa mga residente ang paglalakad pababa ng bundok
questions.explanation: Isinasalaysay ng buong talata ang problema ng layo ng health center, ang pagsisimula ng klinikang umiikot at ang naging bunga nito. Maliliit na detalye o hindi binanggit ang ibang pagpipilian.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ayon sa talata, saan itinatayo ang pansamantalang klinika?
wrong: Sa bahay ng lider ng sitio
questions.explanation: Tahasang sinasabi ng ikalawang talata: "Sa kapilya ng sitio sila nagtatayo ng pansamantalang klinika."

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Batay sa talata, ano ang mahihinuhang dahilan ng pagdami ng mga nagpapatingin?
questions.correct: Nakuha ang tiwala ng mga residente sa tulong ng kanilang mga lider
wrong: Nagsimulang maningil ang klinika ng mas mababang bayad
Ginawang lingguhan ang pagbisita ng klinika sa sitio
Nagtayo ang munisipyo ng bagong health center sa sitio
questions.explanation: Iilan lamang ang lumapit noong una dahil "hindi pa kilala ng mga residente ang mga bagong mukha," kaya nang ang mga lider mismo ang nagpakilala sa mga manggagamot, nagtiwala at lumapit ang mga tao. Libre naman talaga ang serbisyo mula pa sa simula.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng salitang "malubha" sa unang talata?
questions.explanation: Dahil tatlong oras ang lakad, hindi nagpapatingin ang mga residente "hangga't hindi pa malubha" ang sakit, ibig sabihin ay hinihintay muna nilang lumala ito. Magaan ang kabaligtaran nito.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang pangunahing layunin ng paalala?
questions.correct: Ipabatid ang mga tuntunin sa pagbabayad ng amilyar
wrong: Ipahayag ang pagtaas ng amilyar ngayong taon
Ipaliwanag kung paano kumuha ng bagong tax declaration
Ianunsiyo ang mga proyektong kalsada at paaralan ng bayan
questions.explanation: Halos lahat ng bahagi ng paalala ay tungkol sa pagbabayad ng amilyar: ang diskuwento, hulugan, multa, oras ng tanggapan at mga dadalhin. Walang binanggit na pagtaas ng buwis.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ayon sa paalala, ano ang matatanggap ng magbabayad nang buo hanggang ika-31 ng Marso?
questions.explanation: Sinasabi ng paalala na ang magbabayad nang buo hanggang ika-31 ng Marso "ay makatatanggap ng sampung porsiyentong diskuwento." Ang dalawang porsiyento ay ang multa.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Batay sa paalala, ano ang mahihinuha tungkol sa mga nagbabayad nang hulugan sa takdang panahon?
questions.correct: Mas malaki ang kabuuang babayaran nila kaysa sa nagbayad nang buo bago ang ika-31 ng Marso
wrong: Hindi na sila papatawan ng multa kahit maantala ang kanilang bayad
Kailangan nilang magdala ng sulat ng pahintulot sa bawat pagbabayad
Makatatanggap din sila ng maliit na diskuwento sa bawat hulog nila
questions.explanation: Ang nagbabayad nang hulugan ay "wala nang diskuwento," kaya buong halaga ang babayaran nila habang may sampung porsiyentong bawas ang nagbayad nang buo. Ang sulat ng pahintulot ay para lamang sa nagbabayad para sa ibang tao.

questions.subject: Verbal Ability
questions.question: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng salitang "pagkaantala" sa paalala?
questions.explanation: Ang multa ay para sa "hindi mababayaran sa takdang panahon," kaya ang bawat buwan ng pagkaantala ay bawat buwan ng pagkahuli sa pagbabayad. Ang pagpapauna ang kabaligtaran nito.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A government office buys a printer priced at ₱5,000 before 12% VAT. What is the price with VAT?
questions.explanation: VAT is 12% of ₱5,000 = ₱600, so the price with VAT is ₱5,000 + ₱600 = ₱5,600. ₱600 is only the tax.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A receipt shows a total of ₱2,240, which already includes 12% VAT. How much of the total is VAT?
questions.explanation: The total is 112% of the price before VAT, so the price is ₱2,240 ÷ 1.12 = ₱2,000 and the VAT is ₱240. Taking 12% of ₱2,240 (₱268.80) wrongly charges tax on the tax.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: An appliance sales agent earns a 5% commission. How much does she earn on ₱86,000 of sales?

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: Carlo earns a ₱12,000 monthly base pay plus a 3% commission on sales above ₱100,000. This month he sold ₱250,000. What are his total earnings?
questions.explanation: Only ₱250,000 − ₱100,000 = ₱150,000 earns commission, and 3% of that is ₱4,500. Total: ₱12,000 + ₱4,500 = ₱16,500. Taking 3% of all sales gives ₱19,500.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: Liza's salary is 25% more than Jose's. By what percent is Jose's salary less than Liza's?
questions.explanation: Say Jose earns 100, so Liza earns 125. Jose's is 25 less, and 25 ÷ 125 = 20%. The comparison is made against Liza's salary, so it is not 25%.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: Which of these fractions is the largest?

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is 7.2 ÷ 0.08?
questions.explanation: Move the decimal point two places to the right in both numbers: 720 ÷ 8 = 90.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: If A:B = 2:3 and B:C = 4:5, what is A:C?
questions.explanation: Make B the same in both: A:B = 8:12 and B:C = 12:15. So A:B:C = 8:12:15, and A:C = 8:15.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: On a map, 1 cm stands for 5 km. Two towns are 7.5 cm apart on the map. What is the actual distance between them?
questions.explanation: Each centimeter on the map is 5 km, so 7.5 × 5 = 37.5 km.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A gear with 30 teeth turns 40 times a minute and drives a smaller gear with 24 teeth. How many turns a minute does the smaller gear make?
questions.explanation: The same number of teeth pass each minute: 30 × 40 = 1,200, and 1,200 ÷ 24 = 50 turns. The smaller gear must turn faster, so 32 cannot be right.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A bookstore offers "buy 3, get 1 free" on notebooks. What is the effective discount on each notebook?
questions.explanation: You get 4 notebooks for the price of 3, so you save 1 out of 4, or 25%. 33 1/3% compares the free notebook with only the 3 paid ones.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A vendor sells a shirt for ₱450 and earns a 25% profit on her cost. How much did the shirt cost her?
questions.explanation: The selling price is 125% of the cost, so the cost is ₱450 ÷ 1.25 = ₱360. Taking 25% off ₱450 (₱337.50) is wrong because the profit is based on cost.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: Aling Nena bought 50 kg of mangoes at ₱80 per kg. Five kilograms spoiled, and she sold the rest at ₱100 per kg. What was her profit?
questions.explanation: She paid 50 × ₱80 = ₱4,000 and sold 45 kg for 45 × ₱100 = ₱4,500, so her profit is ₱500. ₱1,000 forgets the spoiled mangoes.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: Mang Tonyo borrows ₱12,000 at 9% simple interest per year. How much interest does he owe after 8 months?
questions.explanation: Eight months is 8/12 of a year: 12,000 × 0.09 × 8/12 = ₱720. ₱1,080 is the interest for a full year.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: ₱20,000 is deposited at 8% a year, compounded semi-annually. How much is in the account after 1 year?
questions.explanation: Semi-annual compounding adds 4% every 6 months: 20,000 × 1.04 = 20,800, then 20,800 × 1.04 = ₱21,632. Simple interest at 8% would give only ₱21,600.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A trainee's final grade is 50% exam, 30% project and 20% quizzes. She scored 80 on the exam, 90 on the project and 75 on the quizzes. What is her final grade?
questions.explanation: Multiply each score by its weight: 80 × 0.5 + 90 × 0.3 + 75 × 0.2 = 40 + 27 + 15 = 82. The plain average of the three scores (81.7) ignores the weights.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is the median of 12, 7, 15, 9, 20 and 11?
questions.explanation: Sort the numbers: 7, 9, 11, 12, 15, 20. With an even count, the median is the average of the two middle numbers: (11 + 12) ÷ 2 = 11.5. 12.33 is the mean.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: If 2(x − 3) = x + 5, what is the value of x?
questions.explanation: Expand: 2x − 6 = x + 5. Subtract x and add 6 to both sides: x = 11. Writing 2(x − 3) as 2x − 3 gives 8.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: Jessa has ₱20 more than twice the amount Mark has. Together they have ₱380. How much does Jessa have?
questions.explanation: Let Mark have m, so Jessa has 2m + 20. Then 3m + 20 = 380, so m = 120 and Jessa has 2 × 120 + 20 = ₱260. ₱120 is Mark's amount.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: In 8 years, Liza will be twice as old as she was 6 years ago. How old is she now?
questions.explanation: Let her age be x: x + 8 = 2(x − 6), so x + 8 = 2x − 12 and x = 20. Check: in 8 years she is 28, and 6 years ago she was 14.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: The ratio of Ramon's age to his daughter's age is 7:2, and Ramon is 25 years older than she is. How old is Ramon?
questions.explanation: The difference is 7 − 2 = 5 parts, so each part is 25 ÷ 5 = 5 years. Ramon is 7 × 5 = 35; his daughter is 10.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: Lito can finish a job in 12 days and Ramon can finish it in 6 days. They work together for 2 days, then Ramon leaves. How many more days does Lito need to finish the job?
questions.explanation: Together they do 1/12 + 1/6 = 1/4 of the job a day, so in 2 days they finish 1/2. Lito alone does 1/12 a day, so the other half takes him 6 days.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A train 200 m long passes a lamp post in 10 seconds. What is its speed in km/h?
questions.explanation: The train covers its own length, 200 m, in 10 seconds, which is 20 m/s. To change m/s to km/h, multiply by 3.6: 20 × 3.6 = 72 km/h.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A banca travels 36 km downstream in 2 hours and returns upstream in 3 hours. What is the speed of the current?
questions.explanation: Downstream speed is 36 ÷ 2 = 18 km/h and upstream is 36 ÷ 3 = 12 km/h. The current is half the difference: (18 − 12) ÷ 2 = 3 km/h. 15 km/h is the boat's own speed.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: Ella walks to work. At 5 km/h she arrives 10 minutes late, and at 6 km/h she arrives 5 minutes early. How far is her workplace?
questions.explanation: The two travel times differ by 15 minutes, or 1/4 hour: d/5 − d/6 = 1/4. That is d/30 = 1/4, so d = 7.5 km.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A 40-liter mix of juice concentrate and water is in the ratio 3:1. How many liters of water must be added to make the ratio 3:2?
questions.explanation: The mix has 30 liters of concentrate and 10 liters of water. For a 3:2 ratio, 30 liters of concentrate needs 20 liters of water, so add 20 − 10 = 10 liters. 20 liters is the final amount of water, not the amount added.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What number comes next? 1, 8, 27, 64, ...
questions.explanation: These are the cubes 1³, 2³, 3³, 4³, so the next is 5³ = 125.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What number comes next? 2, 20, 4, 17, 6, 14, 8, ...
questions.explanation: Two series alternate: 2, 4, 6, 8 (add 2) and 20, 17, 14 (subtract 3). The next number belongs to the second series: 14 − 3 = 11.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What number comes next? 1, 2, 6, 24, 120, ...
questions.explanation: Each number is multiplied by the next whole number: ×2, ×3, ×4, ×5, so the next step is ×6 and 120 × 6 = 720.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is the value of 48 ÷ (2 + 6) × 3 − 2²?
questions.explanation: Parentheses: 2 + 6 = 8. Exponent: 2² = 4. Then left to right: 48 ÷ 8 = 6, 6 × 3 = 18, and 18 − 4 = 14. Multiplying 8 × 3 before dividing gives −2.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A triangular lot has a base of 30 m and a height of 18 m. What is its area?
questions.explanation: Area of a triangle = 1/2 × base × height = 1/2 × 30 × 18 = 270 square meters. Forgetting the 1/2 gives 540.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A floor 5 m by 4 m is covered with square tiles 25 cm on each side. How many tiles are needed?
questions.explanation: Along 500 cm, 500 ÷ 25 = 20 tiles fit; along 400 cm, 400 ÷ 25 = 16 tiles fit. 20 × 16 = 320 tiles. Dividing 20 square meters by 0.25 (giving 80) forgets that each tile is 0.25 m × 0.25 m.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A cylindrical water drum has a radius of 35 cm and a height of 1 m. Using π = 22/7, how many liters does it hold when full?
questions.explanation: Volume = πr²h = 22/7 × 35 × 35 × 100 = 385,000 cubic cm. Since 1 liter = 1,000 cubic cm, the drum holds 385 liters. Using 70 cm (the diameter) as the radius gives 1,540.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A bus runs at 90 km/h. What is this speed in meters per second?
questions.explanation: 90 km/h is 90,000 m in 3,600 seconds, and 90,000 ÷ 3,600 = 25 m/s. Multiplying by 3.6 instead of dividing gives 324.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is the smaller angle between the hands of a clock at 3:30?
questions.explanation: The minute hand points at 6, which is 180°. The hour hand is halfway between 3 and 4: 90° + 15° = 105°. The angle is 180° − 105° = 75°. 90° forgets that the hour hand has moved.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is the smallest number greater than 2 that leaves a remainder of 2 when divided by 4, by 5 and by 6?
questions.explanation: A number that 4, 5 and 6 all divide evenly is a multiple of their LCM, 60. Adding the remainder of 2 gives 62.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: What is the greatest common factor of 84 and 126?
questions.explanation: 84 = 2 × 42 and 126 = 3 × 42, and 2 and 3 share no other factor, so the GCF is 42. 252 is the least common multiple.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A barangay recorded rainfall over five days: Monday 12 mm, Tuesday 8 mm, Wednesday 0 mm, Thursday 15 mm and Friday 10 mm. What was the average daily rainfall?
questions.explanation: The total is 12 + 8 + 0 + 15 + 10 = 45 mm, and 45 ÷ 5 = 9 mm. The dry day still counts; leaving it out gives 11.25 mm.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: In a survey of 200 commuters, 90 ride jeepneys, 50 ride tricycles, 40 ride buses and 20 walk. What percent ride a tricycle or a bus?
questions.explanation: Tricycle and bus riders total 50 + 40 = 90, and 90 ÷ 200 = 0.45, or 45%.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A box holds 4 red, 6 blue and 5 green ballpens. If one is picked at random, what is the probability that it is blue?
questions.explanation: There are 4 + 6 + 5 = 15 pens and 6 are blue, so the probability is 6/15 = 2/5. 3/5 is the chance of not getting blue.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A bag has 3 red and 2 white marbles. Two are drawn one after the other without putting the first back. What is the probability that both are red?
questions.explanation: The first is red with probability 3/5. Then 2 red are left out of 4, so the second is red with probability 2/4. Multiply: 3/5 × 2/4 = 6/20 = 3/10. 9/25 assumes the first marble is put back.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: In how many ways can a committee of 3 be chosen from 6 employees?
questions.explanation: Picking 3 in order gives 6 × 5 × 4 = 120, but each committee is counted 3 × 2 × 1 = 6 times, so there are 120 ÷ 6 = 20 committees.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: A 5-kg sack of rice costs ₱260, and a 2-kg pack of the same rice costs ₱108. How much cheaper per kilogram is the sack?
questions.explanation: The sack costs ₱260 ÷ 5 = ₱52 per kg and the pack costs ₱108 ÷ 2 = ₱54 per kg, so the sack is ₱2 cheaper per kilogram.

questions.subject: Numerical Ability
questions.question: The product of two consecutive positive integers is 156. What is their sum?
questions.explanation: Look for two neighbors near √156 ≈ 12.5: 12 × 13 = 156. Their sum is 12 + 13 = 25.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Hungry is to eat as tired is to ___.
questions.explanation: When you are hungry, you eat to fix it. When you are tired, you sleep. A yawn is a sign of being tired, and a bed is where you sleep, but neither is the action that fixes it.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Glove is to hand as boot is to ___.
questions.explanation: A glove is worn on the hand, and a boot is worn on the foot.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Ounce is to weight as liter is to ___.
questions.explanation: An ounce is a unit of weight, and a liter is a unit of volume.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Novice is to expert as apprentice is to ___.
questions.explanation: A novice is a beginner who may one day become an expert. An apprentice learns a trade and may one day become a master. Student and trainee mean much the same as apprentice.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Verbose is to concise as obscure is to ___.
questions.explanation: Verbose (wordy) is the opposite of concise, so the answer is the opposite of obscure, which is clear. Hidden and vague mean about the same as obscure, and brief means the same as concise.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: What comes next? A1, C3, E5, G7, ...
questions.explanation: The letters skip one each time (A, C, E, G, I), and each number is that letter's place in the alphabet. I is the 9th letter, so the next term is I9.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: What letter comes next? B, Y, D, W, F, U, ...
questions.explanation: Two series alternate. The 1st, 3rd and 5th letters go forward by 2 (B, D, F), and the others go back by 2 (Y, W, U). The next letter belongs to the first series: F + 2 = H.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: What letter comes next? A, D, I, P, ...
questions.explanation: The letters' places in the alphabet are 1, 4, 9 and 16, the perfect squares. The next square is 25, and the 25th letter is Y.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: If ROAD is written as URDG, how is MAIL written in the same code?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves three places forward: R→U, O→R, A→D, D→G. So M→P, A→D, I→L and L→O, which gives PDLO.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: In a code, GOLD is written as HQOH. How is SILK written in the same code?
questions.explanation: The 1st letter moves forward 1, the 2nd moves 2, the 3rd moves 3 and the 4th moves 4 (G→H, O→Q, L→O, D→H). So S→T, I→K, L→O and K→O, which gives TKOO.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: The report will not be released unless the director signs it. The report was released. What must be true?
wrong: The director did not sign the report.
questions.explanation: "Not released unless signed" means a released report must have been signed. The statement says nothing about who wrote it.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: All inspectors are licensed. No licensed person is a minor. Which conclusion must be true?
questions.explanation: Every inspector is in the licensed group, and no one in that group is a minor. So no inspector can be a minor.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: One of three clerks broke the office stapler, and only one of the three is telling the truth. Alma says, "Ben did it." Ben says, "I did not do it." Carla says, "I did not do it." Who broke the stapler?
questions.explanation: If Alma or Ben did it, two of the statements would be true. Only if Carla did it is exactly one statement true (Ben's), so Carla broke the stapler.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: If the budget is approved, the project starts in June. If the project starts in June, Rina will lead it. Rina did not lead the project. What must be true?
wrong: Rina declined to lead the project.
questions.explanation: An approved budget would have led to a June start, and a June start would have put Rina in charge. Since Rina did not lead it, the project did not start in June, so the budget was not approved.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: In an exam, Nilo scored higher than Oscar but lower than Pia. Queenie scored lower than Oscar. Ramon scored higher than Pia. Who ranked third?
questions.explanation: From highest to lowest the order is Ramon, Pia, Nilo, Oscar, Queenie. Nilo is third.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Six officers, Lea, Mon, Nora, Pedro, Rey and Sol, sit around a round table facing the center. Lea sits opposite Mon. Nora sits immediately to Lea's right. Pedro sits immediately to Mon's right. Rey does not sit next to Nora. Who sits immediately to Lea's left?
questions.explanation: After placing Lea, Mon, Nora and Pedro, two seats are left: one beside Lea on her left and one between Mon and Nora. Rey cannot sit next to Nora, so Rey takes the seat to Lea's left and Sol sits between Mon and Nora.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Pointing to a girl in a photo, Jun, a man, says, "Her mother is the only daughter of my father." How is Jun related to the girl?
questions.explanation: The only daughter of Jun's father is Jun's sister. The girl's mother is Jun's sister, so Jun is the girl's uncle.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Early in the morning, Celia stands facing her own shadow. Which direction is she facing?
questions.explanation: The morning sun is in the east, so shadows fall toward the west. Facing her shadow means Celia faces west.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Exam applicants by region: Region I 450, Region II 300, Region III 750, Region IV 500. What is the average number of applicants per region?
questions.explanation: The total is 450 + 300 + 750 + 500 = 2,000. Dividing by 4 regions gives 500.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Exam applicants by region: Region I 450, Region II 300, Region III 750, Region IV 500. Region III had how many percent more applicants than Region II?
questions.explanation: Region III had 750 − 300 = 450 more applicants. Compared with Region II: 450 ÷ 300 = 1.5, or 150% more. 250% is Region III as a percent of Region II, not the increase.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Exam results by office: Office A, 80 took the exam and 60 passed; Office B, 50 took it and 40 passed; Office C, 120 took it and 84 passed. Which office had the highest passing rate?
wrong: Office A and Office C tie
questions.explanation: Passing rates are A: 60 ÷ 80 = 75%, B: 40 ÷ 50 = 80%, C: 84 ÷ 120 = 70%. Office C had the most passers, but Office B had the highest rate.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Which one does not belong with the others?
questions.explanation: A mayor, a governor and a barangay captain head local governments. A senator is a national lawmaker.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Pointing to a boy, Teresa says, "His father is my husband's only brother." How is the boy related to Teresa?
questions.explanation: Teresa's husband's brother is her brother-in-law. The boy is the son of her brother-in-law, so he is her nephew.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Pointing to an old man in a photo, Carmela says, "His son is the father of my mother." How is the old man related to Carmela?
questions.explanation: The father of Carmela's mother is her grandfather. The old man is the father of her grandfather, so he is her great-grandfather.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Arturo is the brother of Belen. Belen is the mother of Celso. Celso is the brother of Dina. How is Arturo related to Dina?
questions.explanation: Celso and Dina are siblings, so Belen is Dina's mother too. Arturo is the brother of Dina's mother, so he is her uncle.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Nilo is the son of Olga. Olga is the sister of Pita. Pita is the mother of Quito. Quito is the brother of Rina. How is Rina related to Nilo?
questions.explanation: Quito and Rina are siblings, so Pita is Rina's mother. Pita is the sister of Nilo's mother, so Rina is the daughter of Nilo's aunt, which makes her his cousin.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Lourdes's only son, Danilo, is married to Pia. Pia's only brother is Jomar. How is Jomar related to Danilo?
questions.explanation: Pia is Danilo's wife, and Jomar is Pia's brother. A spouse's brother is a brother-in-law.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Pointing to a woman, Gilbert, a man, says, "Her father-in-law is my father's only son." How is the woman related to Gilbert?
questions.explanation: Gilbert is a man, so his father's only son is Gilbert himself. Gilbert is the woman's father-in-law, so she is the wife of his son, his daughter-in-law.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: Rosa is the mother of Tess and Vic. Vic is the father of a girl named Wena. Tess is the mother of Xander. How is Wena related to Tess?
questions.explanation: Tess and Vic are siblings because they have the same mother. Wena is the daughter of Tess's brother, so she is Tess's niece.

questions.subject: Analytical Ability
questions.question: A family gathering includes one grandfather, one grandmother, two fathers, two mothers, four children, three grandchildren, one brother, two sisters, two sons, two daughters, one father-in-law, one mother-in-law and one daughter-in-law. What is the least number of people at the gathering?
questions.explanation: The grandparents have one son, who is married; his wife is the daughter-in-law. The couple has one son and two daughters, the three grandchildren, so 2 + 2 + 3 = 7 people fill every role.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: A hyphenated surname is filed as one word, ignoring the hyphen. Which name is filed last?
questions.explanation: Read them as SANTORO, SANTOS, SANTOSIDAD and SANTOSREYES. After "Santos", the "r" in Santos-Reyes comes after the "i" in Santosidad, so it is filed last.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Business names that begin with a number written in digits are filed before all names that begin with a letter. Which name is filed first?
questions.explanation: A name starting with digits goes before every name starting with a letter. "Seven Seas" is spelled out, so it is filed under S.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Names are filed word by word, and abbreviations such as Sto. and Ma. are filed as if spelled out. Which name is filed second?
questions.explanation: Sto. is filed as SANTO. The first words in order are SANTIAGO, SANTO, SANTOL, SANTOS; SANTO comes before SANTOL because nothing comes before something.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Government offices are filed under their distinctive name, so "Department of Health" is filed as "Health, Department of". Which office is filed third?
questions.explanation: The distinctive names in order are Agriculture, Budget, Customs, Education. Words like "Bureau of" and "Department of" are not used to sort.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Records are dated month/day/year and filed with the oldest first. Which record is filed first?
questions.explanation: The dates are November 3, 2024; December 1, 2024; January 12, 2025; and March 11, 2025. Compare the year first, then the month: November 3, 2024 is the oldest.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation: Personnel, meaning the staff of an office, has a double n, one l, and ends in -el.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is spelled correctly?
questions.explanation: Miscellaneous has "sc", a double l, and ends in -eous.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which word is misspelled?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is correspondence, ending in -ence. The other three correctly end in -ance.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which is exactly the same as the TIN 409-218-736-000?
questions.explanation: The others differ in one detail: 218 written as 281, the last digit 1 instead of 0, and 409 written as 490.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question:
How many of these pairs are exactly the same?
Ma. Teresa B. Lacson – Ma. Teresa B. Lacson
Ernesto D. Pangilinan – Ernesto D. Pangilinan
Rosalinda M. Ocampo – Rosalinda N. Ocampo
Wilfredo C. Gatchalian – Wilfredo C. Gatchallian
Felicidad A. Soriano – Felicidad A. Soriano
questions.explanation: Lacson, Pangilinan and Soriano match. The Ocampo pair differs in the middle initial (M and N), and the Gatchalian pair has an extra l.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which address is exactly the same as "Unit 3B, 27 Kalayaan Ave., Brgy. Pinyahan, Quezon City"?
questions.correct: Unit 3B, 27 Kalayaan Ave., Brgy. Pinyahan, Quezon City
wrong: Unit 3B, 72 Kalayaan Ave., Brgy. Pinyahan, Quezon City
Unit 3D, 27 Kalayaan Ave., Brgy. Pinyahan, Quezon City
Unit 3B, 27 Kalayaan Ave., Brgy. Pinahan, Quezon City
questions.explanation: The others differ in one detail: the street number 72 instead of 27, the unit 3D instead of 3B, and Pinahan missing the y.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: What is a routing slip attached to a document used for?
questions.correct: To show who must see or act on it, and in what order
wrong: To record the date the document will be destroyed
To show where the document is filed
To mark the document as confidential
questions.explanation: A routing slip lists the people or offices the document passes through, so each one reads or acts on it and sends it to the next.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: A clerk keeps a file arranged by date to remind her of follow-ups and deadlines due on each day. What is this file called?
questions.explanation: A tickler file is a date-ordered reminder file; each day the clerk checks that day's folder for tasks due.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: A receiving clerk stamps each incoming document before logging and routing it. What does the receiving stamp mainly record?
questions.correct: The date and time the document was received
wrong: The date the document was written
The date the reply is due
The date the document will be destroyed
questions.explanation: The receiving stamp shows when the office got the document and who received it, which proves receipt and starts the count for any action.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: A letter marked "CONFIDENTIAL" arrives addressed to the Regional Director. What should the receiving clerk do?
questions.correct: Log it and deliver it unopened to the Regional Director
wrong: Open it and attach a routing slip
Photocopy it for the file before delivering it
Hold it until the Regional Director asks for it
questions.explanation: Confidential mail is recorded as received but opened only by the person it is addressed to.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: A clerk must photocopy a 36-page report, one side per sheet, for 15 offices. How many sheets of paper are needed?
questions.explanation: 36 pages × 15 copies = 540 sheets.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: A clerk encodes 18 forms an hour. She works from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with a one-hour lunch break. How many forms does she encode?
questions.explanation: 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. is 9 hours; minus the 1-hour break leaves 8 working hours. 18 × 8 = 144 forms.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: An office buys 4 boxes of ballpens at ₱185 each, 6 packs of folders at ₱72.50 each and 2 staplers at ₱245 each. What is the total cost?

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which sentence is capitalized correctly?
questions.correct: Please submit the report to the Civil Service Commission on Monday.
wrong: Please submit the report to the civil service commission on Monday.
Please submit the Report to the Civil Service Commission on monday.
Please Submit the report to the Civil Service Commission on Monday.
questions.explanation: The name of an agency and the days of the week are capitalized. Common nouns like "report" and verbs like "submit" are not.

questions.subject: Clerical Ability
questions.question: Which sentence is punctuated correctly?
questions.correct: Please bring the following documents: your ID, your appointment paper, and your PDS.
wrong: Please bring the following documents; your ID, your appointment paper, and your PDS.
Please bring the following documents: your ID your appointment paper and your PDS.
Please bring, the following documents: your ID, your appointment paper, and your PDS.
questions.explanation: A colon introduces a list after a complete statement, and commas separate the items. A semicolon does not introduce a list, and no comma belongs after "bring".

questions.subject: General Information
questions.question: Under the 1987 Constitution, how many successive terms may the Vice President serve?
questions.correct: No more than two successive terms
wrong: No more than three successive terms
